full_judgment: 5. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate appearing for the seven accused appellants submits that two of the accused persons namely, accused Ahmed and Jabbar are dead and the rest of the seven accused appellants have preferred this appeal. The learned Advocate submits that the appeal, being Criminal Appeal No. 6 of 1993 of the co-accused having been allowed by this Court, the order of conviction and sentence passed against these seven appellants need be considered as on the same set of evidence the sixteen accused persons were acquitted by this Division and for ends of justice the case of these accused petitioners needs reconsideration.
